body: Sorry, I'm not familiar with nix_shell. Does that mean `$IN_NIX_SHELL` will never be `1`?

I'm not familiar with it either but it says in the docs that `$IN_NIX_SHELL` should only be `pure` or `impure`:
> IN_NIX_SHELL
>
>   Indicator that tells if the current environment was set up by nix-shell. Since Nix 2.0 the values are "pure" and "impure"

Reference: https://nixos.org/nix/manual/#sec-common-env
